title: RovProfile
description: Standardized definition schema for 6-DOF ROV hydrodynamic profiles and propulsion models.

name.description: Display name of the ROV class.

mass.description: Total dry vehicle mass in kilograms.

inertia.description: Principal moments of inertia [Ix, Iy, Iz] in kg*m^2.

addedMass.description: Diagonal hydrodynamic added mass [X_udot, Y_vdot, Z_wdot, K_pdot, M_qdot, N_rdot].

addedMassMatrix.description: Optional full 6x6 coupled added-mass matrix. Supersedes addedMass if present.

linearDamping.description: Diagonal linear damping coefficients [Xu, Yv, Zw, Kp, Mq, Nr].

linearDampingMatrix.description: Optional full 6x6 coupled linear damping matrix. Supersedes linearDamping if present.

quadraticDamping.description: Diagonal quadratic damping coefficients [Xuu, Yvv, Zww, Kpp, Mqq, Nrr].

leverScale.description: Geometric scale factor mapping profile lever arms to vehicle body dimensions.

cg.description: Center of gravity offset along body Z axis (downward from body origin in meters).

cb.description: Center of buoyancy position [xb, yb, zb] relative to body origin.

buoyancyRatio.description: Ratio of total buoyant force to vehicle weight (B / W). Default is 1.006 (slightly positive).

cameraDistance.description: Optimal chase camera offset distance in meters.

actuatorTau.description: First-order thruster electrical/mechanical time constant in seconds.

f.description: Unit thrust direction [fx, fy, fz] in body frame.

force.description: Maximum forward bollard thrust limit in Newtons.

reverseEfficiency.description: Ratio of reverse bollard thrust to forward thrust (T_rev / T_fwd). Typically 0.65 - 0.85.

deadband.description: Normalized command deadband threshold [-deadband, deadband] within which output thrust is zero.
